what.text: This page follows refugees from Myanmar living in Malaysia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 140238 refugees from Myanmar in Malaysia, 9.2% of all refugees from Myanmar.
Bangladesh hosts by far the most refugees from Myanmar, followed by Malaysia, Thailand and India.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Myanmar in many years, most recently from 2021 to 2025 with the NUG, PSLF, CNF and PNLO.
It also records armed conflict over Kachin territory with the KIO and over Karen territory with the KNU, both active again from 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 5113 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2010 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Malaysia.
These are year-end totals for Malaysia only, reported to UNHCR.
